title: [Workspaces] Migrate Editor from WPF to WinUI 3

status.label: Manual review completion required
status.detail: Eight actual automated requests are exhausted. The final substantive result repeated an unsupported namespace claim; all comments were answered and resolved, with zero unresolved threads. C# enclosing-namespace lookup and the actual unqualified callers counter that allegation; the prior MSTest meta-package allegation was also unsupported. A separate one-line process-basename correction has passing exact literal object compilation and homogeneous raw line endings, but this does not establish whole-migration review convergence, an MSI failure or full WinUI application validation. No approval or ready review is claimed.
